basis.document: 全国大学生嵌入式芯片与系统设计竞赛2026 FPGA创新设计赛道选题指南（紫光同创）
basis.topic: 选题一：基于紫光同创 RISCV 指令集 CPU 设计

requirements.requirement: RV32I，至少三级流水线，数据冲突和分支处理
requirements.qualification: Five-stage current RTL and historical directed-test documentation; not a complete ISA conformance claim.
Current production local module has UART but no T20 GPIO/PWM/I2C endpoint. T20 virtual peripherals are not current physical integration.

requirements.requirement: 2路组相联I/D Cache与总线突发效率
requirements.qualification: Per-set empty-way-first/LRU plus production local SRAM pipeline have actual RTL execution evidence. Combined CPU+local SRAM uses behavioral external DDR; board frequency and DDR behavior remain unmeasured.

Historical CPU retains direction prediction; explicit enhanced profile selects upstream DYNAMIC_TARGET with deterministic startup clearing. Five directed CPU workloads and both short CoreMark seeds pass. New PDS timing/resources are pending.

BRESP is assigned but has no consumer; data access-error path uses RRESP. Production startup disables IRQ, trap handler stops permanently, software IRQ tied zero. Historical injected IRQ coverage is not current board ISR qualification.

requirements.requirement: 边缘AI单元，轻量大模型或YOLO，融合传感器或显示设备
requirements.qualification: Current service runs model/accelerator path; sensor/wiring/actuator not selected or integrated in T26. Host web display must be described accurately; no FPGA-native display claim.
Source-generated CPU variants and real local-SRAM A/B have same-binary dual-seed CRC evidence. All runs are short RTL regressions; formal board scores, new Fmax and LUT denominators remain null.

requirements.requirement: 模型资源、时序、主频、AI延迟与识别率
requirements.qualification: Leased K/V tail, long PV through length512, finite/argmax, prefix reuse, integer phases, bounded timeout and cooperative cancellation are implemented with scoped RTL/native tests. No genuine full-model accuracy or physical board latency has been obtained. Current general FP output-backpressure gate remains FAIL/unresolved. Complete CE passing evidence uses a documented per-element FF simulation representation and fixed external guard/adapter inputs; it is not full SoC or physical DDR qualification. v4 fixes the reported short-PV production Y page crossing and equivalent P/V cases; synthetic production-address CE replay is not a full real-model W or first-Q board pass.

requirements.requirement: 模块化代码、合理时序约束、完整注释及分析报告
requirements.qualification: Bound claims to current source/build/measurement identities; historical PDS and board evidence do not automatically qualify new firmware.

requirements.requirement: 利用ILA波形分析CoreMark关键算法的流水线效率
requirements.qualification: Atomic passive request-window CPU/bus counters are implemented and RTL-tested; prior trace tools remain available. Neither PMU simulation nor RTL traces substitutes for a current board ILA capture.

requirements.requirement: CoreMark设置迭代次数并保证不少于10秒
requirements.qualification: Use actual completed timing and official CRC checks; do not promote short-run iteration-rate output to a formal score.

new_work_scope.full_ce_validation_scope: Documented simulation representation, M1/M4 K/V and 65x7 PV with modeled DDR and fixed external guard/adapter status; not full SoC or full model.
new_work_scope.pv_dma_page_boundary: Fixed for short/long P reads and Y writes, plus short V row reads; same production descriptor/DMA rules retained. See verification/v4.
